name: print-social-flyer-orange-delivery-photo-rounded-panel
title: Orange delivery service flyer with rounded photo panel
whatItIs: A delivery-service social flyer pairing a warm orange photo of a smiling customer with a large rounded dark panel overlapping the image, containing the offer copy and checkmark features.
whatItMeans: Letting a rounded content panel overlap directly onto the photo (rather than sitting beside it) merges photo and message into one continuous composition.
techniques: overlap a large rounded content panel onto the edge of a photo rather than placing it beside it
use a duotone-orange treatment on the photo so it harmonizes with a flat orange background
pair checkmark icons with short benefit phrases for fast scannability

vocabulary.definition: a distinct shaped area (often rounded or angled) used to hold text separately from a background image
